forever_changes.text: Racial traits are reworked for Forever.
Humans can be Hunters, one of six new race and class pairs.
Every race has two active and two passive racial abilities, tuned for similar offensive power.

Racials in the beta client's spell data: Will to Survive removes all Stuns on a 3 minute cooldown, Perception gives 20 seconds of stealth detection on a 3 minute cooldown, Ruthless increases critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 1%, and The Human Spirit increases Spirit by 10%.

forever_changes.text: Racial traits are reworked for Forever.
Orcs can be Mages, one of six new race and class pairs.
Every race has two active and two passive racial abilities, tuned for similar offensive power.

Racials in the beta client's spell data: Blood Fury increases Attack Power, Ranged Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 seconds on a 2 minute cooldown, Shatter Curse removes all Curses and Banes and reduces magical damage taken by 5% for 8 seconds on a 3 minute cooldown, Command increases the damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets by 5%, and Hardiness reduces stun duration by 20%. Savage, the 1% critical strike passive that had replaced the axe bonus, is removed.

forever_changes.text: Racial traits are reworked for Forever.
Shaman is a new Dwarf class in Forever, shown in a hands-on demo at BlizzCon 2026 per one outlet.
One press roundup reports that the reworked Dwarf racial grants a bonus against beasts; Blizzard has not confirmed it directly.
Dwarves can be Shamans, one of six new race and class pairs.

Racials in the beta client's spell data: Stoneform removes and grants immunity to Bleed, Poison and Disease effects and reduces physical damage taken by 10% for 8 seconds on a 3 minute cooldown, in place of the old armor bonus; Find Treasure tracks treasure; Artisan's Precision increases hit chance with spells and attacks by 1%, in place of Earth Fury's critical strike bonus since Blizzard's 26 October notes; Big Game Hunter increases damage dealt to Beasts by 5%. That Find Treasure stacks with other tracking is Blizzard's Deep Dive, not the client's rows.

forever_changes.text: Shaman is available to Skyborne only on the Horde and Mage only on the Alliance.

Racials in the beta client's spell data: Walk on Air (glide downward for 10 seconds on a 90 second cooldown), Read Leyline (50% health and mana regeneration for 15 seconds on a 2 minute cooldown), Wind Blessed (2% haste), Elemental Insight (5% damage to Elementals). Skyborne choose Horde or Alliance at creation. Read Leyline is spell 1259705, which casts Energized 1270842. The sim does not cast it on its own; a custom rotation can.
